'''Indigo Five''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Unidentified pilot (Indigo Five)|member]] of [[Indigo Squadron (New Republic)|Indigo Squadron]] who flew during the [[Battle of Galantos]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant" />
